new_libraries.name: DevLab_TrafficLights
new_libraries.author: UNIT Electronics MX
new_libraries.maintainer: Adrian Rabadan, Cesar Bautista, Jonathan Mejorado, Fernando Flores
new_libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the UE0183 I2C traffic lights module using the DevLab Device Protocol (DDP).
new_libraries.paragraph: DevLab TrafficLights library to drive the red, yellow and green LEDs through DDP over I2C (Device ID 0x0116, address 0x36).
